responsibility: This header specializes the C6X ELF target for the uClinux environment by defining OS preprocessor builtins, dynamic-linker and startup/link specs, a default DSBT driver self-spec, and the inline instruction-cache flush sequence used for trampolines or generated code. It is the operating-system configuration companion to the generic C6X ELF headers, controlling libc/startup integration and Linux-specific runtime conventions rather than the core instruction-selection backend.
